name: Bleeding Strike (Combat)
body:
Your critical hits cause foes to bleed lightly.

Benefit: When you score a critical hit, your target also suffers a bleed effect. The hit point loss caused by the bleed each round is equal to the critical multiplier of the attack you used. Thus a Bleeding Strike attack with a longsword deals a bleed 2.
